title: Test-Driven AI Coding: Stop AI Grading Itself
description:
Don't let AI grade its own work. Write the test first! ✅

✅ Write a short pytest test that says what the code must return
✅ Run it and watch it fail (red) before any code exists
✅ Tell the AI to make it pass without editing the test

Day 5 of Spec-Driven AI! Next up, Day 6: Add Acceptance Criteria to Every Prompt.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to build with AI the right way.

#shorts #coding #programming #python #ai #aicoding #tdd #vibecoding
comment: Pytest or xUnit: which would you use first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: tell the AI not to edit the test, so it has to fix the code instead of changing the test to pass.
